messages:
claire (Marketing): Uploaded draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-draft-2026. Need quick passes on 1) audience hooks (PM vs infra), 2) safe benchmark copy, 3) webinar signup routing. Short replies pls :pray:

noah (Product): Quick thought: top-line 2-line PM TL;DR, then an infra highlight card with numbers. Two CTA paths but one form with hidden segment field is cleaner.

ari (Growth): Single HubSpot form + hidden field is best. Use ?seg=pm or ?seg=infra. I'll map to workflows once copy locked. Snippet: `<form action="https://forms.hubspot.com/submit/launch2026"><input type="hidden" name="audience_segment" value="__SEG__"><input name="email" type="email" required><button>Reserve seat</button></form>` Replace __SEG__ via URL param.

mika (Design): I can make two hero variants and a small features->buyer table to help routing. Webinar seats = 240. I can style a waitlist CTA if needed. ETA 3h.

jordi (Legal): Avoid absolutes. Use "up to" for numeric claims, name baseline (e.g., "NVIDIA A100 40GB baseline"), include benchmark link and short methodology box, and add a one-line disclaimer: "Results may vary by workload and deployment."

seat-bot: Config set: warn_threshold=210, waitlist_threshold=230, hard_cap=240. Will post counts at 180, 210, 230, and when full.

claire (Marketing): Perfect. Noah, can you draft the PM TL;DR and a safe benchmark sentence that matches Legal? I'll fold design assets and Ari will wire the HubSpot mapping; aiming to hand to comms for copy lock tomorrow morning. :rocket:
